title: Digital Video Processing
description: Representation of digital video. Image formation models. Spatio-temporal sampling and sampling structure conversion. Two- and three-dimensional motion estimation techniques. Optical flow, block-based and pel-recursive methods for motion estimation. Still image and video compression methods and standards. Interface compression and model-based methods for video compression. Digital video systems and applications. Students are required to complete a project.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECE 583, ECE 483, ELEC 483, ELEC 583.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
